reason: Researched 2026-10-31 via WebSearch/WebFetch (Fed statement, Trading Economics US/bond wraps, Alphabet Q3 coverage, ANET/AMD earnings calendars). The 10-30 tape was an AI-valuation selloff: S&P -1.8%, Nasdaq 100 -3.5%, NVDA -4.2%, AMD -11%, MU -5.3%, AVGO -5.5%, Intel -23%+, after Alphabet (EPS miss, FCF -$9B, 2027 capex signalled >$300B), Amazon (Q3 miss, higher capex) and Intel (weak guidance) made investors question AI capex returns; Nasdaq finished October -6.6%. The Fed held 3.75-4.00% on 10-28 with Cook and Hammack dissenting FOR a hike, core PCE 3.1%, and a December hike ~72-83% priced. My legs are NVDA -5.7%, MU -2.2%, AMD -6.2%, TSM -3.4%, ANET -7.7%, BTC -5.7% against stops of -15%/-18%/-20% from the 10-19 fills, so none is near its exit. I hold rather than trade for three reasons. (1) The fundamental thesis is not what broke: hyperscaler capex is going UP (Alphabet 2027 >$300B, Amazon raised again), Micron's HBM is sold out for 2026 under take-or-pay contracts, and AWS capacity is sold out into 2027; that is the demand for exactly these chips, memory, foundry and switches. What is happening is multiple compression under a 5% 10-year and a hiking Fed, plus the market punishing the spenders' negative free cash flow. (2) A replacement book would re-base every stop off a lower 11-02 fill, i.e. loosen my absolute exit levels right before AMD reports on 11-03 and ANET on 11-02/03 after the close; the current stops (NVDA ~184.5, AMD ~457, ANET ~155.5) are the pre-committed answer to a bad print and cap each earnings outcome at roughly 1-2% of NAV. (3) I will not add into the washout either: with hike-dissenters at the Fed, the AI-capex-ROI narrative turning, the midterms on 11-03 and NFP on 11-06, the 37% cash at 4% is worth more as dry powder than as a fourth attempt to catch the semiconductor bottom; the 10-19 re-base already bought one washout that kept falling. The 10-year falling to a seven-week low of 4.93% is the one supportive datum for multiples and argues for patience, not churn. Not verified despite searching: the AWS growth line in Amazon's Q3 and the AMD-specific driver of its 11% drop (reported as Intel read-through and rotation); if AMD's 11-03 print shows a data-center GPU miss rather than client weakness, the stop does the work. BTC at 5% stays as the small contrarian leg at ~$77.2k.
